decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - You are advised that the proposed development is noted within our records to be located won the site of a former landfill.  Therefore, we advise that either the site is investigated for the presence of landfill gas to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required or that gas protection measures are installed as a precautionary measure.  Please contact the Land Quality Team on landquality@hounslow.gov.uk if you require any advice.

Condition : 4 - The approved attenuation measures set out in the Sound Pressure Levels specifications submitted shall be carried out prior to the use of the approved combined cooling heating and power unit and maintained whilst the combined cooling heating and power unit or in accordance with a programme agreed with the local planning authority, prior to commencement of works.
description: Installation of a combined cooling heating and power unit
